findings.reason: The cited evidence confirms the event and traffic surge, but does not prove 'crowd congestion' as the specific mechanism.
T4 explicitly states S-TUN-002 active users were above baseline from 19:00 to 22:30.
T4 confirms dl_volume and prb_util for both sites were above baseline from 19:15 to 22:30.
EVT-004 text confirms the concert location near S-TUN-001 and the exact time window.
ALM-000633 and ALM-000634 show HIGH_PRB warnings on both sites within the event window.
T6 and T7 outputs explicitly report no maintenance or changes for the specified nodes and time window.
